unit: All India (Imperial Tables; province/state level only) - fallback for Coorg, Delhi etc.
title: Census of India, 1931, Vol. I; India; Part II.-Imperial Tables
layout: Landscape (rotated) pages. Part I: rows = languages (classified by family), columns = India and each province/state/agency x Persons/Males/Females (no districts). Part II Bilingualism (515-517): rows = mother tongue x province/state/agency of return, columns = subsidiary languages.
scan_quality: Good 300ppi scan; OCR useless (rotated). Alt: tdl.49856-census-of-india-1931-vol-i-india-part-ii-imperial-tables (index files unavailable at time of check).

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.2 (andaman And Nicobar Islands) Pt.1 Report And Pt.2-tables
layout: Single upright page. Rows = languages (A Vernaculars of India, B Other Asiatic, C European); columns = Total / Andamans / Nicobars x Persons/Males/Females. No bilingualism part.
scan_quality: Good, clear. Combined Part I Report + Part II Tables. Same scan as in.ernet.dli.2015.531273 and in.gov.ignca.31100.

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.3 Assam Pt.2 Tables
layout: Landscape (rotated) pages. Part I: rows = districts/divisions of Assam incl. Manipur & Khasi States, columns = languages (Persons/Males/Females), grouped A Vernaculars of Assam, A(ii) of India outside Assam, B Asiatic, C European. Part II Bi-lingualism: rows = districts, columns = mother tongue x subsidiary language (Males/Females).
scan_quality: Good, 600ppi, clear print; leaf 260 blank.

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.4 (baluchistan) Pt.1 Report And Pt.2 Imperial And Provincial Tables
layout: Upright pages in facing pairs. Part I: rows = languages, columns = districts (Quetta-Pishin, Loralai, Zhob, Bolan, Chagai, Sibi) and states (Kalat and its divisions, Las Bela, Kharan) x M/F. Leaf 382 is a summary statement; 387 blank; 388 Part II intro. Part II Bilingualism: rows = mother tongue within district/state, columns = subsidiary languages (local / non-local) M/F; 5 openings.
scan_quality: Good. Combined Report+Tables volume (430 leaves). Alt: in.ernet.dli.2015.62802 (408 leaves, different scan), in.gov.ignca.31103 (OCR files unavailable at time of check).

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.5 Bengal And Sikkim Pt.2 Report
layout: Upright pages. Part I (mother tongue by locality and sex): rows = ~91 languages (serially numbered, grouped A-G), columns = localities x Both sexes/Males/Females. Part A (leaves 192-201): all Bengal + each district incl. Calcutta + states (Cooch Behar, Tripura); Part B: cities; Part C (leaf 202): Sikkim; Supplement I (leaf 202) and Supplement II (leaf 203, details of combined dialect entries). Part II Bi-lingualism: A (205-214) mother tongue by subsidiary language, B (215-224) subsidiary language by mother tongue, by district.
scan_quality: Good, 600ppi, crisp. Title says Pt.2 Report but it is Part II Tables. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31105. in.ernet.dli.2015.98736 (582 leaves) is another copy.

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.6 Calcutta Pt.1 And 2
layout: Single upright page. Rows = 71 languages grouped A-G; columns = Calcutta with suburbs and Howrah / Calcutta / Suburbs in 24-Parganas / Howrah City x Both sexes/Males/Females. Part II not printed (leaf 182 states this).
scan_quality: Good. Parts I and II in one item. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31106.

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.7 (bihar And Orissa) Pt.2 Tables
layout: Landscape (rotated) pages. Part I Mother tongues: rows = province, British territory, divisions and districts, Feudatory States (Orissa States, Chota Nagpur States); columns = languages x Persons/Males/Females (Indo-Aryan, Munda, Dravidian, other Indian, Asiatic, European). Part II Bi-lingualism: by district/subdivision, mother tongue x subsidiary language. Leaf 125 blank.
scan_quality: Good, legible; OCR of table pages useless (rotated). Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31108.

unit: Bombay Presidency (British districts and Bombay States and Agencies)
title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.8 Pt.2 (bombay Presidency ) Statical Tables
layout: Upright pages, facing pairs. Leaf 363 = summary statement of totals by language group. Part I: rows = Presidency, divisions, districts, then Bombay States and Agencies and individual states (~90 serial rows); columns = languages x Persons/Males/Females, Group A Indian languages, Group B Asiatic (372-373). Part II Bilingualism (374-406): one mother tongue per opening (Kanarese, Brahui, Baluchi, Siraiki, Kachchhi, Marathi, Konkani, Western Hindi, Gujarati, Bhili, Ahirani, Rajasthani, Telugu, English...), rows = areas of bilingualism (districts/states), columns = subsidiary languages M/F.
scan_quality: Good, clear; slight skew. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31110.

title: Census of India 1931 vol.8; pt.3 (Bombay Presidency ) Aden-Report and tables
layout: One opening (leaf 35 = divider title page). Rows = languages grouped A Indian, B Asiatic, C European, etc.; columns = religions (All religions, Hindu, Muslim, Jain, Zoroastrian, Christian, Sikh, Jew, Buddhist) x Persons/Males/Females. Aden only, no district breakdown.
scan_quality: Colour scan, yellowed paper, legible. Same leaves in in.ernet.dli.2015.56030 (greyscale).

unit: Cities of the Bombay Presidency (Bombay, Karachi, Poona, Sholapur, etc.)
title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.9 (cities Of The Bombay Presidency) Pt.1 Report, Pt.2 Statistical Tables
layout: No language city table. Part II City Tables cover area, variation, religion, age, literacy, birthplace, occupation only. Only language material: report chapter II sections 15-16 (Language, Bilingualism, printed p.37, around leaf 70) and Appendix C Part II (leaf 179, p.136: children aged 4-15 in Bombay City by main languages and wards). Bombay City/Karachi etc. appear as rows in Vol. VIII Imperial Table XV.
scan_quality: n/a

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.10 (western India States Agency) In Two Parts Pt.1 Report Pt.2 (statistical Tables)
layout: Upright facing pairs. Leaf 451 = details of other languages in each group. Part I: rows = Agency, sub-agencies and individual states (Kathiawar, Western Kathiawar, Eastern Kathiawar, Sabar Kantha, Cutch etc.); columns = languages x Persons/Males/Females, Group A Indian, B Asiatic, C European. Part II Bilingualism: one mother tongue per opening (Sindhi, Kachchhi, Marathi, Western Hindi, Gujarati, ..., English), rows = areas of bilingualism, columns = subsidiary languages M/F.
scan_quality: Good. Combined Report+Tables. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31114; in.ernet.dli.2015.62780 is a different scan (510 leaves).

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.11 (burma) Pt.2- Tables
layout: Upright pages. Part I-A (226) classification of languages; I-B (227-231) provincial totals of speakers of each language (rows = languages, M/F); I-C (232-233) alphabetical index; I-D (234-237) distribution of language-groups by districts and states (rows = districts, columns = language groups M/F); I-E (238-239) distribution of selected languages (Arakanese, Shan, Karen etc.) by districts. Part II Bilingualism (240-241): rows = district x mother tongue, columns = subsidiary languages.
scan_quality: Good. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31116.

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.12 (central Provinces And Berar) Pt.2- Report
layout: Upright facing pairs. Part I: rows = province, divisions/districts and Feudatory States (serial-numbered), columns = languages (by family: Aryan, Dravidian, Austric/Munda, unclassed; B Asiatic, C European) x Persons/Males/Females. Appendix to Part I (358-364): details of languages/dialects not shown separately. Part II Bi-lingualism: rows = area of bilingualism (district/state x tahsil or zamindari) grouped by mother tongue, columns = subsidiary languages.
scan_quality: Good. Title mislabelled Pt.2 Report; it is Part II Tables. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31118.

unit: Madras Presidency (with Madras States: Pudukkottai, Banganapalle, Sandur)
title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.14 (madras) Pt.2 Report
layout: Landscape (rotated) pages. Part I Mother-tongue: rows = districts and states, columns = languages x Males/Females (A Vernaculars of India: (1) languages of the Presidency, (2) other Indian; B Asiatic; C European). Part II Subsidiary languages: blocks per mother tongue (Konkani, Korava/Yerukala, Oriya, Saora, ...), rows = districts, columns = subsidiary languages.
scan_quality: Good 600ppi scan but rotated table pages; OCR useless for tables. Title mislabelled Pt.2 Report. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31121. Tamil Digital Library copies tdl.57608 / tdl.57798 (343 leaves) are alternatives.

unit: North-West Frontier Province (districts + trans-frontier posts; tribal agencies separately where shown)
title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.15 (north-west Frontier Province) Pt.1- Report, Pt.2- Tables
layout: Part I (one opening, 358-359): rows = languages, columns = N.-W.F. Province, districts (Hazara, Peshawar, Kohat, Bannu, Dera Ismail Khan) and trans-frontier posts x Persons/Males/Females. Part II Bilingualism (360-371, 6 openings): rows = area of bilingualism x mother tongue, columns = subsidiary languages (Pashto, Lahnda, Punjabi, Hindustani, Urdu, Hindi, ..., English) M/F.
scan_quality: Good. Combined Report+Tables (460 leaves). Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31122. Report chapter X Language at leaves 200-213 incl. linguistic map (201).

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol Xvi Delhi
layout: Leaf 207 (p. liii) = Table XV intro with a small statement of minor languages (Other Indian/Asiatic/European) and a BI-LINGUALISM heading with nothing beneath; leaf 208 (p. liv), which should carry the Part I table, is BLANK in this scan (image mean ~1.0).
scan_quality: PROBLEM: Table XV data page missing/blank in the only copy found. Delhi totals by language are available in Vol. I Part II Imperial Table XV (india.history.resource.92539). Combined Report and Tables volume.

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.17 (punjab) Pt.2 Report
layout: Upright facing pairs. Part I: rows = Punjab, British territory, divisions/districts and Punjab States (serial-numbered), columns = languages x Persons/Males/Females (Vernaculars of the Punjab, other Indian vernaculars, Asiatic/African, European). Part II Bi-lingualism: rows = districts/states, columns = mother tongue (Lahnda, Hindustani, Western Pahari, Pashto, ...) x subsidiary language.
scan_quality: Good. Title mislabelled Pt.2 Report; it is Part II Tables. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31124.

unit: United Provinces of Agra and Oudh (British territory + Rampur, Tehri-Garhwal, Benares States)
title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.18 (united Provinces Of Agra And Oudh) Pt.2 Report
layout: Upright facing pairs. Part I Mother tongue: rows = province, British territory, Agra/Oudh provinces, divisions, ~48 districts and states (serial-numbered); columns = languages x Persons/Males/Females: Part A (1) Vernaculars of the Province, (2) Vernaculars foreign to the Province (Panjabi, Rajasthani, Marathi, Gujarati, Pashto, Bengali...), Part B non-Indian Asiatic, Part C European. Part II Bi-lingualism: one opening, rows = districts, columns = mother tongue x subsidiary language M/F.
scan_quality: Good. Title mislabelled Pt.2 Report; it is Part II Tables (658 leaves). Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31126.

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.19 (baroda) Pt.2- Tables
layout: Table XV in three parts. Part A (one opening 116-117): rows = languages with dialects, columns = Baroda State total, Baroda City, Amreli, Baroda, Mehsana, Navsari divisions and Okhamandal x Persons/Males/Females. Part B Bilingualism (118) and Part C Polylingualism (119), one page each.
scan_quality: Good. Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31128.

title: Census of India 1931 vol.20 (Central India agency); pt.2 (Tables)
layout: Upright facing pairs. Leaf 297 = Part I intro with summary statement by language family. Part I: rows = Central India Agency, agencies (Bhopal, Bundelkhand, Indore, Malwa, Baghelkhand...) and individual states; columns = languages x Persons/Males/Females. Appendix to Part I (308-310): details of languages not separately shown. Part II Bilingualism (311 intro + table, 312-315): rows = states by mother tongue, columns = subsidiary languages. Leaf 316 blank.
scan_quality: Colour scan of yellowed paper; legible at full resolution but lower contrast than DLI greyscale. Only copy found of Part II (IGNCA only; DLI has Part I Report only).

title: Census Of India 1931 Vol.21 (cochin) Pt.1 (report) Pt.2 (a And B Tables)
layout: Part I (single page 436): rows = languages, columns = Cochin State Persons/Males/Females only (no district breakdown). Part II Bi-lingualism (437-438) with Supplement (439, persons speaking more than one subsidiary language): rows = mother tongue, columns = subsidiary languages M/F. District-level language data is only in Report ch. X Subsidiary Table II 'Distribution by language of the population of each district' at leaves 287-288 (pp. 227-228); linguistic map at leaf 280-281.
scan_quality: Good. Combined Parts I and II (492 leaves). Same scan as in.gov.ignca.31131; in.ernet.dli.2015.116059 is another scan (477 leaves).

title: Census Of India, 1931 Vol Xxii Gwalior Part - Ii
layout: Upright pages. Leaf 149 = Table XV title/notes (Part I Language, Part II Bi-lingualism); 150 blank. Part I A District details (151-157): rows = languages and dialects (A Languages of India: (1) proper to State, (2) other; B Asiatic; C European), columns = Gwalior State and districts (Gird, Isagarh, Bhilsa, Ujjain, Mandsaur, ...) x Persons/Males/Females; Part I B Cities (158, Lashkar City etc.). scan_quality: Good greyscale scan; leaf 151 appears to be a continuation page placed before the opening page 152 - check page order when transcribing. Only Part II copy found (DLI 116061).

rotated_pages: Part I rotated, Part II upright
